communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1) Contracts and data sharing agreements with any agency, company, consortium, or other entity that has a database interface (live access to read/write) with your RMS or CAD system. For example, this document leads up to believe that LexisNexis has a live interface into your RMS system: https://edocs.rentonwa.gov/Documents/DocView.aspx?id=10188275&dbid=0&repo=CityofRenton

2) Any contracts, addendums, or data sharing agreements with LexisNexis for Accurint Virtual Crime Center (AVCC), with Shotspotter/SoundThinking for CrimeTracer (or Coplink X), or with any federal agency to share local police data, in bulk, with third parties.  

CONTEXT: We seek to understand how local police records are accessed by federal agencies via private (e.g. AVCC) and public (e.g. N-DEx) data pipelines.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
